notes:
- Improved automatic Closest Join for straight Satin columns. With pull compensation, touching same-color columns can sew continuously, with the connecting stitches under the receiving column’s Satin cover.
- Jumps Only keeps the transition needle-up. An actual gap, including one created by shortening a column with push compensation, still uses the normal connection settings.
- Installed and portable StitchFits share this update. The integrated Auto Digitize and Photo Tools are included.
